tbesh_html:
1) to seek, seek early or earnestly, look early or diligently for
1a) (Qal) to look for diligently, seek
1b) (Piel) to seek, seek early

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to dawn, i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (do something) betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek diligently) early, in the morning).
